spot.interpretation: Large asynchronous venue discrepancy. Kraken supplied no event timestamp; no synchronized depth or executable cross-venue opportunity was established.

order_book.reason: Only top-of-book was available from the direct exchange responses. The accessible Swiftedge book view is perpetual-market/JavaScript-rendered and did not expose a raw numeric snapshot.

derivatives.conclusion: No synchronized current multi-venue OI/funding snapshot admitted. Provider universes and timestamps remain non-comparable.

exchange_wallets.source: XRP Radar, daily validated-ledger wallet reads
exchange_wallets.interpretation: A floor of publicly attributed wallet balances, not immediately tradable inventory. Customer omnibus/cold-storage and wrapped-token backing must not be treated as free float.

escrow.caveat: The 70% re-lock/300M net-release figure is historical tracker methodology, not a guaranteed future release or sell amount.

xrp_insights.universe: six US spot funds plus BITW; issuer-derived holdings deltas

alpha_finance.universe: five-fund cohort; excludes XRPR and includes GXRP

crypto_keyhole.universe: four daily issuer-file funds: Bitwise, Franklin, Canary, 21Shares

etf_flows.interpretation: These trackers overlap issuer files but use different fund universes, settlement vintages and missing-file rules. The XRP Insights download and live dashboard differ by approximately 0.929M XRP. Do not average or treat holdings deltas as pure cash subscriptions.

cftc.interpretation: Net-long positioning is not spot ownership; the weekly changes are consistent with short-covering contributing to the net-long increase.

tokenized_rwa.interpretation: The $4.06B registry component is platform-locked or represented notional, not freely transferable investor float.

x402_operator_index.quality_note: Recent rows are labeled Unverified despite the page's verified-before-settle description.

xrp_radar_x402_crosscheck.interpretation: Operator and aggregator totals disagree; no averaging. High payment-request counts do not imply large XRP monetary throughput.

ledger_and_adoption.escrow_and_wallet_caveats: The supply-breakdown page mixes live on-chain reads with static Q3-2024 Ripple operational holdings and January-2026 founder estimates; do not treat the entire 100B allocation chart as a synchronized point-in-time feature.

onchain_attribution_tracker.interpretation: Unknown destinations are not evidence of sale; the tracker is not a complete custodian ledger.

share_count_reconciliation.class_c_rights: Non-voting except limited protective matters, but entitled to dividends and liquidation distributions.
share_count_reconciliation.correction: The XRP Radar tracker says no filing reported share count, but the SEC 8-K and Nov 9 424B3 do report class counts. The Nov 9 prospectus also identifies Company Units and contingent dilution. Do not calculate XRP per share using a simple A+C or fully diluted sum until class/unit/redemption rights and intervening conversions are reconciled.
share_count_reconciliation.sbi_interpretation: 39.9% is the disclosed voting-power percentage/ownership cap, not evidence that SBI supplied 39.9% of cash or XRP.

coinbase_circle.coinbase_circle_equity_link: Coinbase Q3 2026 10-Q records fair-value remeasurement of its investment in Circle Internet Group after Circle's IPO; the filing excerpt does not disclose a percentage.
coinbase_circle.interpretation: Circle distribution costs and Coinbase stablecoin revenue are different accounting measures; they are not a one-to-one reconciliation.

circle_other_links.arc_note: Arc is a separate Layer 1; ARC presale revenue is not USDC reserve capital or XRP demand.

institutional_relationships.ripple_coinbase: RLUSD distribution on Coinbase Prime, Exchange and Retail is live; Coinbase Global Exchange collateral support was described as forthcoming, not live.
institutional_relationships.ripple_lmax: Ripple provided approximately $150M financing to LMAX; RLUSD collateral integration across institutional FX/crypto markets is described as planned. This is RLUSD, not XRP collateral.
institutional_relationships.standard_chartered: RLUSD custody on XRPL is live; collateral mirroring with LMAX/Ripple remains planned and subject to documentation/testing/approvals.
institutional_relationships.bny: BNY supports XRP and RLUSD custody and is RLUSD reserve custodian; no XRP collateral utilization disclosed.
institutional_relationships.sbi_ripple: SBI Ripple Asia is 60/40 SBI Group/Ripple and provides RippleNet software services; Ripple says the JV does not directly handle XRP. SBI Remit/SBI VC Trade/Tranglo is the separate XRP remittance route; transaction volume not disclosed.
institutional_relationships.sbi_circle: SBI Circle Holdings/Circle SBI Japan is a 50/50 JV; SBI Holdings and SBI Shinsei each invested $25M in Circle's IPO.
institutional_relationships.direct_relationship_limit: No direct SBI-Coinbase commercial partnership or direct Circle-XRP settlement relationship verified.

identity_research.sbic: SBIC East/Tokyo, SBIC Central/Nagoya and SBIC West/Osaka are regional SME investment companies, distinct from SBI Holdings. SBIC East's official pages document ChatGPT/generative-AI education, including a seminar co-hosted with the Tokyo Chamber of Commerce; this is training, not an OpenAI commercial partnership.
identity_research.ask_coin: Permission Coin (ASK) is one plausible exact-name match on Base/Polygon from secondary token listings; no canonical XRPL issuer/deployment verified. Do not conflate with XRP.
identity_research.actual_capital: No distinct entity or protocol named Actual Capital verified. The phrase is generic; maintain cash, in-kind XRP, debt, ELOC capacity, warrants and secondary resales as separate categories.
